## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Mixed confirmations: Materials/Healthcare/Industrials strength versus broad Technology mega-cap weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META BELOW TREND) support a neutral, range-bound market.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%), sector up 1W +16.20%. Healthcare strong: ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%) and JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +6.39%). Industrials showing strength: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%). Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -14.43%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -13.49%). Financials mixed with pockets of weakness: BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) even as JPM is ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%), BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%), PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.06% | 1M: -2.42%), NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -14.37%). Weakness concentrated in Technology and select Materials/Financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) , AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%), CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%), ABBV (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%), INTC (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%). No MAJOR divergence across mega-caps (most tech mega-caps show 1W and 1M weakness), so momentum is concentrated in cyclicals and healthcare.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak (1W: -2.62% | 1M: -4.20% with 24 stocks) with broad mega-cap pressure: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%), while AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) and INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%) are exceptions.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed: 1W: -0.33% | 1M: +3.88% (20 stocks). Leaders: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.24%); laggards include BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) and CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%) — watch for dispersion within the sector.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive: 1W: +3.61% | 1M: +4.41% with multiple leaders — JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +6.39%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +12.96%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Materials, Healthcare and selective Industrials given current leadership (DD, JNJ, UNH, CAT, AMAT). Reduce exposure to large-cap Technology mega-caps showing confirmed weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META BELOW TREND) and to Financial names with fresh downside (BLK, CME). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective and tilt to confirmed ABOVE TREND names.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%). BEARISH: ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%), CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W +16.20%) and Healthcare (1W +3.61%) — watch follow-through. BEARISH: Technology (1W -2.62%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W -1.46%) — monitor mega-cap earnings/news flow.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch follow-through or fade in DD after the 1W spike for sustainable ABOVE TREND confirmation; AMAT to hold recent breakout and extend 1M outperformance; AAPL/MSFT/NVDA reclaiming 1W/1M trend lines would remove a major headwind; ORCL needs to stabilize above its recent gap to ease downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+55): UnitedHealth Group — AI cost-cutting/dividend focus; price confirming with UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%) — sentiment confirmed. DE (+80): Deere — guidance/AI buyback tailwind; price data not in the detailed view provided here, watch for follow-through. QCOM (+75): Qualcomm — raised growth target and AI positioning; price data not in the detailed view, monitor confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMGN (-85): Amgen — EU regulator action; price not in detailed view here, watch for downside if confirmed. GOOGL (-45): Alphabet — talent losses to rivals and sentiment drag; GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -11.56%) — sentiment confirmed. CME (-45): CME Group — target cut; CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%) — sentiment confirmed. ORCL (-40): Oracle — report of partner/IPO delay; ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%) — divergence tilted toward distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL; style: mixed / no clear leadership.  
JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +6.39%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: broad Technology mega-cap weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META BELOW TREND) and negative news/signals in ORCL and CME that could widen dispersion.
